asset_upload.asset_file: relative path under assets/incoming OR file_b64

apply_semantic_objects.objects: array of {document, semantic_id, data, build_id?, provenance?, classification?}

resize_scene.width: scene width in pixels, safe range 1000-100000
resize_scene.height: scene height in pixels, safe range 1000-100000
resize_scene.result: before/after dimensions; supports expected_revision at command level

inspect_3d_capabilities.returns: installed module versions, safe camera settings, 3D runtime methods, selected token render state, discovered Scene/Tile flag names
inspect_3d_capabilities.security: fixed module and setting allowlists; no arbitrary JavaScript execution or settings enumeration

inspect_3d_native_workflows.returns: core/Premium BuildPanel button registration and disabled status, actual Props browser instance, selected 3D token and camera prerequisites
inspect_3d_native_workflows.security: no invocation of 3rd-party callbacks, no changes to UI or Scene

set_native_camera_mode.token_id: explicit selected 3D token ID for first person
set_native_camera_mode.dry_run: true by default in MCP wrapper
set_native_camera_mode.effects: temporary GM camera only, no scene document writes

preview_native_asset_tile.foundry_path: approved local module GLB/GLTF path only
preview_native_asset_tile.returns: source mesh bounds and a calculated read-only Foundry Tile candidate
preview_native_asset_tile.safety: never creates or edits Tile; output is not visual QA

direct_rpc.purpose: synchronous MCP-to-Foundry command path; bypasses Drive command files
direct_rpc.security: agent remains loopback-only and module remains GM-only
